coaching.headline: The Fey snowballed off Lt. Belica, Riktor and Eden, and after the allied Mini Prime the team lost every detected fight.

flags.text: The Fey's 16/2/3 and 77488 hero damage led the game; 59% of enemy kills came from mid.
Lt. Belica's nine deaths were a damn feed: seven to The Fey, four outside any detected fight.
Rampage died outside detected fights; next fight lost 0-3, then enemy Fangtooth and Orb Prime.
Enemy won five fights and cashed all five; the allied side took one structure all game.

focus.title: Answer The Fey before fighting
focus.action: Buy magical armor by the second item on any hero The Fey keeps killing, start fights only after Fly Trap is spent, and with the jungler dead, concede Fangtooth and hold the mid inner.

13.5.call: Won 3-2 with kills from Eden, Lt. Belica and Rampage, two at the Prime pit, and Rampage then took Mini Prime. Keep turning won fights into objectives before resetting.

15.4.call: Lost 0-2 as The Fey killed Riktor on the mid lane and Eden in the enemy jungle, and enemy Fangtooth came next. Hold mid only with vision on The Fey.

19.1.call: Four allied deaths for one kill on the offlane in the allied half, Riktor's on Bayle, then The Fey took the offlane outer. Eden fell first; once the carry drops there, disengage.

23.7.call: With Rampage already dead, Riktor, Eden and Lt. Belica died in the allied jungle for zero kills, then enemy Fangtooth. While the jungler is down, wait for the respawn before contesting the pit.

27.9.call: Akeron and Eden fell in the same second after the enemy Shaper take, and the duo inner, three inhibitors and the Core went in a row. After an enemy Shaper take, group all five on the inhibitors before taking any fight.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gold ended 12.6k against The Fey's 22.5k; CS per minute 6.2 against an own average of 8.2. When that far behind, farm mid under tower before joining offlane fights.
The Fey has no dash and one hard catch, Fly Trap. Hold Seismic Assault until Fly Trap is spent, then commit; until then, stay outside Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth.
Both kills landed on The Fey, accounting for every death The Fey took. Save Neural Disruptor's silence for The Fey in every fight.
ac34f298-6713-4561-808c-9911ca7873f4: Kill participation of 67%, 8 wards placed and 5 enemy wards cleared, the allied high for clears. Keep clearing enemy wards before each Fangtooth.
Four of five deaths to The Fey; 27901 hero damage taken was magical. Once Fly Trap is spent, open Skewer on The Fey, a mage without a dash.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: First blood on Scarlett, then Fangtooth and Mini Prime taken, with 10110 objective damage, the allied high. When Scarlett shows across the map, keep taking the opposite objective.
Hero damage per minute ran 353 against an own average of 546. When a fight opens on The Fey, spend Boulder Throw and Pounce there first.
9d47ad8c-dab4-47d0-98fe-d3779e47cdd6: Six kills, the allied high, plus the only allied structure: the duo outer. When the duo lane is ahead, take the next duo tower before walking to mid fights.
Three of six deaths went to The Fey, and the build held no magical armor item. When The Fey snowballs, make the fourth item magical armor instead of Infernum.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Three kills, all on Bayle, and three deaths to Bayle in return, with zero assists. Trade only after dodging the third slash of Cursed Edge, and disengage during Berserk.
Kills on Bayle never became a tower: the enemy offlane outer stood all game. After the next won Bayle trade, hit the tower before Bayle respawns.

augment: Wanton Warden returns a share of damage taken as health over a few seconds, growing with level.

crest: Safeguard active shields the support and nearby heroes and grants tenacity while the shield holds.
Rift Walkers leans ahead of Sanctification in this support field; both evolve from Warden Crest.
improvement: Transference over Dynamo completes the 60.6% core and adds magical armor, giving up Dynamo's damage amp on immobilized targets.
Mending with Glacier over the damage minors adds magical armor as gold comes in, giving up Frost Snap damage.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Pick up Boulder Throw, Pounce in to shatter it on landing for an area stun, Rumble to slow, then Behemoth to grow, heal and get an instant Boulder Throw and longer Pounce.
ourKits.winCondition: Engage with Pounce and Boulder Throw, then out-sustain fights in Behemoth, especially near several enemies.
ourKits.passive: King of the Jungle: bonus health regeneration, doubled in the jungle, and tenacity plus a heal when he is immobilized.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that punishes the targets he stuns and knocks back.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge the thrown boulder and watch for him carrying one before a Pounce. Anti-heal cuts his regeneration and Behemoth healing, and kiting him out of Behemoth's duration wastes it.

ourKits.combo: poke with Sidewind's Railshot and Tachyon Lance at range, swap with Zero Shift, dash in with Talon Drive and Axiom Strike, then Limit Break once Overheated
ourKits.winCondition: build Heat by damaging heroes and unload Limit Break, flexing between range and melee
ourKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Heat; at max Heat she Overheats and unlocks Limit Break, and Heat decays if she stops hitting heroes
ourKits.playWith: peel that lets her keep damaging heroes to build Heat safely
ourKits.playAgainst: disengage to let her Heat decay before she Overheats; punish melee stance after Talon Drive is spent, and buy anti-heal against her melee stance healing; armor blunts her physical damage

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
ourKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
ourKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
ourKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
enemyKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
enemyKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

enemyKits.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
enemyKits.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
enemyKits.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
enemyKits.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
enemyKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
enemyKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
enemyKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
enemyKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 2,672 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of The Fey mid players this patch (48% of the team's). The damage came from Astral Catalyst, Tainted Scepter, Caustica.
Fly Trap at rank 3: 95s base, about 51.9s by the end (45% shorter) from 83 ability haste: Timewarp 25, Astral Catalyst 20, Tainted Scepter 10, Noxia 20, Soulbearer 8.
19 takedowns (16 kills, 3 assists) fed: Astral Catalyst, Tainted Scepter (Malice), Nature's Vengeance (passive).
Timewarp (Chime): Every 8s: Subtract 1s from Non-Ultimate Cooldowns.
Astral Catalyst (Ravenous): Hero Kills reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 25%.• Hero Assists reduce your Ultimate Cooldown by 15%.
The Fey dealt 77,488 hero damage, 48% of their team's, with +550 magical power from items.

Penetration: Caustica ignores 35%; against Lt. Belica (level 16: about 86 magical armor, 56 after penetration; took 17,159 magical damage from heroes, 69% of all hero damage they took) and Riktor (level 13: about 51 magical armor, 33 after penetration; took 27,901 magical damage from heroes, 60% of all hero damage they took) that is about 19% and 14% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Astral Catalyst (item): On damaging a Shielded Target: Deal 40% bonus Damage. Does not exceed the size of the Shield.
Tainted Scepter (item): On Dealing Magical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 4s.
Tainted Scepter (item): Once every second: Gain a stack of Malice. Stacks up to 15 times. Takedowns grant 15 stacks instantly. Hitting a Hero with Ability Damage will deal 1.5 (+1%) Damage per stack.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.
Aion (Eternal): Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.

Sustain: Astral Catalyst: On damaging a Shielded Target: Deal 40% bonus Damage. Does not exceed the size of the Shield.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 3,135 healing recorded.
Toughness: +200 health; took 22,657 damage, mitigated 13,934, died 2 times.

Lesson: The Fey's penetration cut through: Lt. Belica took about 19% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 16 their armor was about 86, about 56 after 35% penetration).

bullets: Bramble Patch then Untamed Growth on a marked hero fired Noxia, on a cooldown; Caustica hit harder on heroes above 50% health with bonus magical armor.
Astral Catalyst cut Fly Trap's cooldown by 25% per hero kill and 15% per assist, so 16 kills brought the pull and stun back far sooner.
Aion: each cast stacked mana regeneration; Arcane Resonance turned that regeneration into faster basic ability cooldowns and faster Philosopher gold, up to 50%.
Dire Howl gave Bayle Omnivamp for 5s, then healed Bayle for part of the damage taken during that buff, on top of the item healing.
Krix raised Bayle's maximum health and size; Voracity restored health and gold per unit kill; Feeding Frenzy added attack speed per nearby enemy hero, adding Overlord splash hits.
Dealing or taking damage built Fist Of Razuul stacks toward an empowered basic attack, while enemies basic attacking Bayle took Tainted Guard's bleed and a healing cut.
